### Patch Changes

- 1b3a297: Bun.SQL is the only Postgres driver and the postgres-js fork is gone.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: breaking
  title: Bun.SQL replaces postgres-js as the only Postgres driver
  detail: createDbConnection opens a Bun.SQL pool and needs Bun 1.4.4 or newer, the first release that drops a cached statement plan after DDL on the same connection. The handle gains listenClient for LISTEN/NOTIFY. Server errors carry the code ERR_POSTGRES_SERVER_ERROR with the SQLSTATE in errno and the constraint name in constraint; connection failures carry ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_CLOSED, ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_REFUSED, ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT or ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_FAILED. extractPgError, isUniqueViolation, isTableAlreadyExists, constraintOf and the newly exported isUndefinedTable read that shape. The onNotice option is removed, because Bun.SQL has no notice hook and drops server notices. The ssl option takes Bun's tls value (a boolean, "disable", "prefer", "require", "verify-ca", "verify-full" or a TLS options object); ssl true and a TLS object without rejectUnauthorized still verify the server certificate, as they did with postgres-js. DB_PROVIDER is refused at boot for every non-empty value, "postgres" included.
  migration: Read SQLSTATE and constraint only through extractPgError or the is* helpers from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/db; a direct err.code === "23505" check or an err.constraint_name read no longer matches. Replace checks for CONNECTION_CLOSED, CONNECTION_ENDED, CONNECTION_DESTROYED or CONNECT_TIMEOUT with the ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_* codes. Drop onNotice from createDbConnection calls. Remove DB_PROVIDER from every environment. Run on Bun 1.4.4 or newer in engines, CI and images. Code that imports postgres itself must declare its own dependency or move to Bun.SQL, since the framework no longer installs it. Manual migration, there is no codemod.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: types
  type: breaking
  title: DbConnection, DbTx and PgClient are Bun.SQL types and postgres is no longer a peer dependency
  detail: DbConnection is SQL | RawDbClient, DbTx is TransactionSQL | RawDbClient and PgClient is SQL from the bun module, so the package type-checks against bun-types instead of postgres. The postgres peer dependency is removed.
  migration: Remove postgres from your dependencies unless your own code imports it. Annotations that named postgres.Sql or postgres.TransactionSql for framework handles become SQL and TransactionSQL from "bun", or the DbConnection and DbTx aliases. Manual migration, there is no codemod.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: testing
  type: breaking
  title: captureClosedConnectionError returns a Bun.SQL error
  detail: The helper opens Bun.SQL pools, so the captured error has the code ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_CLOSED instead of the postgres-js CONNECTION_CLOSED. The client of createTestDb is the connection handle's listenClient, the same Bun.SQL pool as before.
  migration: Tests that compared the captured error's code with CONNECTION_CLOSED compare with ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_CLOSED or call isClosedConnectionError. Manual migration, there is no codemod.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: server-runtime
  type: fix
  title: The renderer-web stylesheet fallback checks tailwindcss in node_modules
  detail: canResolveTailwindStylesheet looks for tailwindcss in the node_modules directories above the stylesheet, as Tailwind does, instead of asking Bun.resolveSync. On Bun 1.4.4 the resolver auto-installs tailwindcss next to a renderer copy in Bun's install cache, so a build without a node_modules tree took the fallback and then failed in Tailwind with "Can't resolve 'tailwindcss'". Such a build skips the fallback stylesheet again.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: dev-server
  type: improvement
  title: Scaffolded apps pin Bun 1.4.4
  detail: The deploy Dockerfile template, the managed public CI workflow and the scaffolded bun-types range move from Bun 1.4.0 to 1.4.4, the minimum the Bun.SQL driver needs. The managed CI workflow updates on the next sync; the deploy Dockerfile is only written at scaffold time.
  migration: Raise BUN_VERSION in an existing deploy Dockerfile to 1.4.4 and bun-types to ^1.4.4 by hand.
  -->
- ed98312: Settle and consume racing on a swept cap reservation book their units again, schema status and baseline use one connection, package lookups no longer auto-install from the registry, and fresh scaffolds build with `bun run build`.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: cap-counter
  type: fix
  title: Settle and consume racing on a swept reservation book their units
  detail: After the sweep deleted a reservation's row, a consume could commit its released tombstone between the two reads of a parallel settle or consume. That call took the released tombstone for a settled one, so settle reported success without booking its amount and a second consume was rejected with cap_reservation_settled. Only a settled tombstone counts as settled now; a released one runs into the insert conflict and the retry books against it.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: improvement
  title: schema status and baseline use one connection, bun-types is a peer dependency
  detail: kumiko schema status and baseline open a pool of one connection instead of the default size, because Bun.SQL dials every pool connection on the first query. bun-types is now a peer dependency (^1.4.4) of framework, types, server-runtime and dev-server instead of a regular dependency, so install it next to the framework.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: server-runtime
  type: improvement
  title: Package lookups no longer auto-install from the registry
  detail: The new @cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime/resolve-installed-package export looks up node_modules before asking Bun.resolveSync, which installs missing packages from the registry since Bun 1.4.4. The prod build, the dev-server stylesheet lookup and the handbuch commands use it.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: dev-server
  type: improvement
  title: Scaffolded docker-compose raises Postgres max_connections to 300
  detail: Bun.SQL dials its whole pool eagerly, so the default limit of 100 is too tight for an app plus its tests. Existing apps can add command postgres -c max_connections=300 to the postgres service.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: dev-server
  type: fix
  title: Fresh scaffolds build with bun run build
  detail: create-kumiko-app now writes public/index.html with the /styles.css and /client.js placeholders. Without it kumiko-build stopped with a missing-template error, so the scaffolded Dockerfile could not build either.
  -->
- 947470b: `ctx.loadAggregate(id, { atVersion })` reads only the event at that stream version, upcast and scoped to the tenant like the full load. The workflow runner uses it to follow a trigger or awaited event reference, so a resume no longer loads the whole stream of the referenced aggregate.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: improvement
  title: ctx.loadAggregate can read a single event by version
  detail: The new atVersion option returns the event at that version of the stream (or nothing), with upcasting and the tenant filter. It cannot be combined with asOf. Workflow resume uses it for event references.
  -->
- 8a6508a: The layout editor edits the scope of the screen it was opened from. Before, a SystemAdmin who clicked Edit on a system-origin layout row on the tenant screen silently edited and published the system layout for all tenants. The tenant overview now always opens the tenant editor, the platform overview opens the new `platform-layout-editor` screen (SystemAdmin only) for the system layout, the editor asks `layout-source` for `scope` tenant or system, and `layout-source` refuses `scope: "system"` for anyone but a SystemAdmin.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: document-designer
  type: fix
  title: layout editor scope follows the entry screen
  detail: The tenant overview opens layout rows in the tenant editor even for a SystemAdmin, so a system-origin row there loads and saves the tenant layout through layout-source with scope tenant and upsert-tenant. The platform overview opens the new platform-layout-editor screen (PLATFORM_LAYOUT_EDITOR_SCREEN_ID) for the system layout. layout-source takes an optional scope and answers 403 to scope system for non-SystemAdmins. templateRowActions now takes { platform }.
  -->
- 9253635: `copy-locale` of a template with linked files now reads each source file through the storage provider of the tenant that owns it. Before, it read through the caller's provider, so with one provider per tenant the files of a system template looked missing and the copy silently lost its images and attachments. A file whose row exists but whose bytes cannot be read now fails the copy with `templateResolver.errors.resource.sourceUnreadable` and stores nothing.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: template-resolver
  type: fix
  title: copy-locale reads source files from the owning tenant's storage
  detail: The copy of linked files uses readFileRefContent with the provider of the fileRef's tenant. A source file whose fileRef row exists but whose bytes cannot be read fails the copy with template_resource_source_unreadable and releases the files already copied. A deleted fileRef is still left out of the copy.
  -->
- f75a6dd: The waitlist `notifyRecipient` resolver now runs with a `ctx.systemDb` bound to its own savepoint. Before, a resolver whose SQL statement failed (missing table, constraint, timeout) put the submit transaction into the aborted state: the submit answered 500 and stored no entry, although the JS error was caught. Now the savepoint rolls back and the entry is stored. Statements through other `ctx` handles (`ctx.query`, `ctx.write`) still share the submit transaction.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: waitlist
  type: fix
  title: A failing notifyRecipient SQL statement no longer aborts the submit
  detail: The resolver receives a ctx whose systemDb runs in a savepoint, so a failed statement is rolled back and the submit answers 200 with the entry stored. Only ctx.systemDb is savepoint-scoped; other ctx handles stay in the handler transaction.
  -->
- bd1b61a: Deleting a secret under an undeclared key is rejected when the key carries the prefix of a mounted feature, so a tenant admin can no longer remove feature-owned rows outside their writeRoles. Legacy keys without a mounted-feature prefix stay deletable.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: secrets
  type: fix
  title: Feature-prefixed undeclared secret keys are not deletable
  detail: The delete handler still accepts legacy undeclared keys, but a key starting with "<feature>:" of a mounted feature now fails as unknown key. Feature-owned credentials keep their writeRoles protection.
  -->
- 5947ab0: Integration tests now cover the erasure wiring of forget-subject and runForgetCleanup for a user stored before the KMS existed.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: crypto-shredding
  type: improvement
  title: Tests pin the erasure write purpose in forget-subject and the forget cleanup
  detail: A pre-KMS user whose key was already erased still ends deleted, loses its tokens and gets the erased sentinel in the update event.
  -->
- 7d5f95c: The tenant-destroy `subject-keys` stage no longer erases the user key of a member who still belongs to another tenant that is not destroyed. Before, it tombstoned the key of every member, so a user who also belonged to a live tenant got `subject_erased` on every later PII write there.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: tenant-lifecycle
  type: fix
  title: Tenant destroy keeps user keys of members in other live tenants
  detail: The subject-keys stage erases user keys only for members without a membership in another tenant whose status is not destroyed. The tenant and tenant-record keys are erased as before.
  -->
- 2dd1de3: Mail steps no longer repeat a send that cannot succeed or may already have gone out. A mail runner failure with an SMTP 5xx `smtpCode` is recorded at once instead of being retried three times, and a mail runner that throws is recorded as failed without a retry, because a mail has no idempotency key and the provider may have accepted it before the error. Failures without a code and 4xx codes are still retried; webhook steps keep their retries under the Idempotency-Key.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: step-dispatcher
  type: fix
  title: Mail steps do not retry permanent rejections or throws
  detail: MailDispatchResult failures take an optional smtpCode; 5xx is permanent and recorded after the first attempt. A throwing mail runner is not retried, since the message may already be sent. A mail runner that wants a retry after a transport error should return a failure without smtpCode instead of throwing.
  -->
- 7336a78: A calendar cap settle on a swept or released reservation books the actual amount before it writes the settle tombstone, so a lost counter version race no longer commits a tombstone without the booking. A test now races several such settles on one counter and expects the full amount.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: cap-counter
  type: fix
  title: Settle after a sweep survives a lost counter race
  detail: The amount is booked first and the tombstone written afterwards, so a version conflict on the counter retries the whole settle instead of leaving a tombstone that turns the retry into a no-op and drops the usage from the cap.
  -->
- f0c2983: Every failed agent tool result now carries a `code`. Bad arguments and a missing handler or screen return `invalid_tool_call`, a tool name that is not in the table returns `unknown_tool`; both are exported as `TOOL_CALL_ERROR_CODES` so an agent loop can branch on them like on a handler code.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: agent-tools
  type: improvement
  title: Local agent tool errors carry a code
  detail: dispatchToolCall returns code invalid_tool_call for validation errors and unknown_tool for an unknown tool name, instead of a result without code. TOOL_CALL_ERROR_CODES names both.
  -->
- c14ccd3: The unsubscribe link origin is resolved once per notify call and tenant, so the app's `tenantOrigin` callback no longer runs once per recipient and a bad value logs one warning per call instead of one per recipient. Tests cover the single lookup, the single warning without error text or addresses, and the form and JSON answers of a resubscribe at the generation limit.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: delivery
  type: fix
  title: Unsubscribe link origin is looked up once per notify call
  detail: The tenantOrigin callback runs once per tenant for a notify call with many recipients, and a fallback warning is logged once. A callback that hangs is still not guarded by a timeout, so keep it fast.
  -->
- 6bb9d66: A test now proves that a waitlist purge whose key shred fails midway rolls back cleanly and that a retry completes it, so the KMS tombstones already written and the retry's audit event leave no half-erased state behind.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: waitlist
  type: improvement
  title: waitlist purge retry after a failed shred is covered
  detail: An integration test fails the second key shred of a purge, checks that the entries stay and no audit event is written, and that the retried purge erases every entry and records its audit event. No runtime change.
  -->
- 9a72476: `purgeFilesReachingSubject` reads the candidate rows of a user subject in id-ordered pages instead of loading every row the user owns at once. Failures were already collected per row and thrown at the end; that stays.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: crypto-shredding
  type: improvement
  title: The subject file purge reads candidate rows in pages
  detail: A user owning many records no longer loads them all into memory at once; every page is purged, not only the first.
  -->
- 9253635: `patch-draft` `replaceText` now says why a find that is visible in `document-blocks` does not match. A find that crosses a formatting change fails with `text_spans_formatting`, and a find containing a `{{placeholder}}` fails with `placeholder_not_replaceable`, instead of `text_not_found`. The handler description names the limit: the text must lie within one formatting run and cannot contain a placeholder.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: template-resolver
  type: improvement
  title: replaceText explains finds across formatting or placeholders
  detail: replaceText matches inside single text nodes so formatting stays intact. A find that appears in the block line but crosses a formatting change now fails with text_spans_formatting, and a find with a {{placeholder}} fails with placeholder_not_replaceable, both with translated messages. Only a string that is not in the block at all still gives text_not_found.
  -->
- e5fe5f2: Host-routing rejects a redirect whose `from` is an `/api` path at boot, because redirects only run for requests that reach the HTML fallback and such a rule would never fire.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: host-routing
  type: fix
  title: Redirects from /api paths fail at boot
  detail: Redirects run inside hostDispatch after static files and API routes, so a from of /api or /api/... was silently dead config. Boot validation now throws; the options and README already describe the HTML-fallback scope.
  -->
- bec6021: `send-test-status` now uses the same roles as `send-test`: SystemAdmin plus the roles of the `tenantEditable` entries. Before, it was fixed to TenantAdmin and SystemAdmin, so an editor with an opt-in role got a 403 and a permanently disabled test-mail button, while a TenantAdmin without edit rights was told `canSend: true` and hit a 403 on click.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: template-resolver
  type: fix
  title: send-test-status follows the tenantEditable roles
  detail: send-test-status takes its access from templateEditAccess(policy.tenantEditable), like send-test. Roles that may send a test mail now get the status, and a TenantAdmin without an edit opt-in gets a 403 on both.
  -->
- bec6021: The template `overview` query now uses the same roles as the write handlers: SystemAdmin plus the roles of the `tenantEditable` entries. Before, it was fixed to TenantAdmin and SystemAdmin, so a role that the app opted in saw the screen but got a 403, and a TenantAdmin without an opt-in reached the query and got an empty list.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: template-resolver
  type: fix
  title: overview follows the tenantEditable roles
  detail: The overview query takes its access from templateEditAccess(policy.tenantEditable). An opted-in role lists exactly the released templates, and a TenantAdmin without an opt-in is refused with a 403, matching the screen visibility and the write handlers.
  -->
- cee9e32: Tests now prove that the echoed write event is absent from `dispatcher.write` and `dispatcher.batch` results and from agent tool call results, the entry points used by websocket writes, agent tools and jobs.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: improvement
  title: event-free write results proven for non-HTTP entry points
  detail: Integration tests assert that dispatcher.write, dispatcher.batch and the agent tool dispatch return no event. No runtime change: all of them already pass through the dispatcher masking.
  -->
- bec6021: The template `overview` search and the `title` sort now work on the title as the admin sees it. Before, a template seeded with `titleI18nKey` was searched and sorted by its raw key, so searching for "Tilgungsplan" found nothing. The query resolves the key with the locale of the request.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: template-resolver
  type: fix
  title: overview search and sort use the translated title
  detail: The overview query translates a seeded titleI18nKey with the request locale before it filters by search and sorts by title. A search for the visible title now matches, and the raw key is still searchable.
  -->
- 59028a5: An app mounted under a URL prefix gets working default auth pages. `createKumikoApp({ basePath })` passes the prefix to the default nav adapter and exposes it to the auth gates through the new `BasePathProvider` / `useBasePath` (plus the pure `normalizeBasePath`, `stripBasePath`, `prependBasePath`). The default auth pages gate matches `/admin/unlock-account` and friends, and the login screen's default forgot-password and unlock links carry the prefix.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: renderer
  type: improvement
  title: basePath option for createKumikoApp and the auth pages
  detail: createKumikoApp accepts basePath. The default auth pages gate matches its paths below the prefix, and the login screen builds its default forgot-password and unlock hrefs with it, so mail links to /admin/unlock-account no longer end on the login screen. New exports BasePathProvider, useBasePath, normalizeBasePath, stripBasePath and prependBasePath.
  -->
- d6940f1: The legacy waitlist migration now applies the live field limits (name, email, locale, company, portfolio, message). A source row above a limit is counted as `unreadable` and not imported; `importWaitlistEntry` throws for such an entry. Before, the value was stored and could never pass a later update through the same payload schema. An offlot row whose city, stock, country and notes lines add up beyond the message limit is the typical case.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: waitlist
  type: fix
  title: Waitlist import enforces the live field limits
  detail: migrateLegacyWaitlist counts a source row with a value above the live field limit as unreadable instead of importing it; importWaitlistEntry throws for it.
  -->
- 2602c62: `UserDataRightsHandlers` and `UserDataRightsQueries` list every user-data-rights write and query handler and are exported from the feature and its `/web` entry.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: user-data-rights
  type: improvement
  title: Complete, exported handler name constants
  detail: UserDataRightsHandlers now covers all eight write handlers and UserDataRightsQueries all five explicit query handlers, and both are exported from user-data-rights and user-data-rights/web. A test compares them with the feature's registered handlers.
  -->

## 0.388.0

### Minor Changes

- 4e3bb2c: The jobs feature takes `readRoles` so app roles can read their tenant's job failures and runs.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: jobs
  type: improvement
  title: readRoles for tenant job status
  detail: `createJobsFeature({ readRoles: ["PropertyManager"] })` lets those app roles call `jobs:query:failures` and `jobs:query:tenant-runs` for their own tenant. They are added to the default `User`, `Editor` and admin roles, which stay. Before, a member who only holds app roles got access_denied.
  migration: Optional. Apps whose members hold only their own roles pass `createJobsFeature({ readRoles: [...] })`.
  -->
- 453b3f0: Six-cell one-time code input for the MFA screens: autofocus, auto-submit on the last digit in login and setup, and a recovery-code switch in verify, disable and regenerate.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: renderer
  type: breaking
  title: Input gets kind "code" and autoFocus on kind "text"
  detail: Input has a new kind "code" (length, onComplete, autoFocus, autoComplete defaulting to one-time-code), a single real input shown as separate cells; onComplete fires once when input, paste or autofill reaches full length and the value holds digits only. kind "text" gains autoFocus.
  migration: custom Input implementations (PrimitivesProvider override) with an exhaustive switch over props.kind need a case "code"; delegating to DefaultInput from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/web is enough
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: auth-mfa
  type: improvement
  title: Six-cell code input, autofocus, auto-submit and recovery switch
  detail: The MFA login, setup, disable and regenerate screens use the six-cell code input with autofocus. Login and setup submit automatically on the sixth digit; disable and regenerate keep the explicit confirm button. Verify, disable and regenerate can switch to a recovery-code field. New keys auth.mfa.verify.useRecoveryCode, useAuthenticatorCode, recoveryCode and recoverySubtitle in all locale packages; auth.mfa.disable.code now names the authenticator code only.
  -->
- 1425622: Dodo Payments as a subscription provider, and billing-foundation offers several providers side by side.

It verifies Standard Webhooks signatures, maps Dodo events to the foundation events, creates hosted checkouts and portal sessions, and switches plans in the app through previewPlanSwitch and applyPlanSwitch. Config keys are api-key, webhook-secret, billing-live and environment. Plan switches need a Product Collection in Dodo.
  -->

  type: improvement
  title: dodoEnvSchema declares the Dodo product id slots
  detail: dodoEnvSchema({ prices: ["PRO"] }) adds one optional DODO_PRODUCT_PRO slot per plan next to the API key and webhook key, and checks the pdt_ prefix. It is the counterpart to stripeEnvSchema.

  title: Several subscription providers in one catalog
  detail: The billing-plans query returns providers (name, displayName, plans, note) when more than one provider is offered, and start-plan-checkout takes providerName. consumerProtection.providerTexts overrides checkoutNote and vatNote per provider, and the consent record carries providerName. switch-plan always uses the provider of the existing subscription.

  <!-- kumiko-changes

  type: improvement

  detail: A provider plugin that implements previewPlanSwitch and applyPlanSwitch switches plans without a hosted portal. The new plan-switch-preview query returns the proration, the billing-plans result carries inAppPlanSwitch, and the panel shows PlanSwitchConfirmDialog with the withdrawal consent checkboxes. The confirmation mail is sent when the plan_changed webhook arrives with the consent id.

  <!-- kumiko-changes

  type: breaking
  title: A catalog with several providers no longer throws an ambiguous-provider error
  detail: With more than one subscription provider mounted, billing-plans and start-plan-checkout used to throw. They now list the providers; start-plan-checkout answers with errors.providerRequired when several are offered and no providerName is given, and errors.providerNotOffered for an unknown one. Plugins have to set displayName.
  migration: Set displayName on custom subscriptionProvider plugins. Callers that send start-plan-checkout with several providers mounted must pass providerName.

  <!-- kumiko-changes

  detail: billing.stripe is now optional and billing.dodo is new (priceToTier, oneOffPriceIds). At least one is required. resolveBillingOption returns features (an array) instead of feature, and one webhook route serves every provider on stripe.webhookPath or SUBSCRIPTION_WEBHOOK_PATH. DODO_PAYMENTS_API_KEY and DODO_PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_KEY are the env bridge.
  migration: Callers of resolveBillingOption use billing.features instead of billing.feature.

  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: locale-de
  type: improvement
  title: German strings for the provider choice and the in-app plan switch

  detail: ChoiceCards is a card-styled radio group (title, description, aside, native radios, keyboard operable) for exclusive choices that need more than a segment label. PlanCardPrice takes an optional prefix shown before the amount, for example "from".
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: billing-foundation
  type: improvement
  title: Provider choice moved into the checkout dialog
  detail: The plan panel no longer shows a provider switch. Cards show the first provider's price, or the cheapest one with a "from" prefix when providers disagree. With several providers, or with consumerProtection, choosing a plan opens CheckoutConsentDialog, which now has an optional providerChoice (ChoiceCards with the checkout note and, when prices differ, the price), an optional note, and an optional consumerProtection (without it there are no checkboxes and the order carries no consent). The plan switch dialog shows the recurring price with its interval.

  feature: subscription-stripe
  type: fix
  title: A malformed stored credential no longer leaks into the error
  detail: A stored api-key or webhook-secret that is not valid JSON used to raise the JSON parser's own message, which repeats the value into logs and the webhook 401 body. The error now has a fixed text and names no input. subscription-dodo behaves the same.
  -->

### Patch Changes

- ff553d1: config:query:values and config:query:cascade accept an optional read scope.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: config
  type: improvement
  title: config:query:values and config:query:cascade accept a read scope
  detail: Both queries take an optional scope (system, tenant, user). With scope system the cascade of a tenant or user key is evaluated at system level, so the system row is returned even when the caller's own tenant has a row for the key. Only a SystemAdmin gets the narrowed read; other callers keep the normal cascade. Inherited-value redaction still applies. Without scope the behavior is unchanged.
  -->
- ed4e21b: Billing and waitlist review fixes: contract termination no longer records twice for concurrent runs, revocation resumes a cancel recorded mid-flight, subscription sync carries a provider event time, waitlist link-on-signup surfaces failed updates, the offlot legacy migration skips entries it imported before, and the purge audit event is written before keys are shredded.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: billing-foundation
  type: fix
  title: Concurrent termination runs, revocation resume and sync ordering
  detail: record-contract-termination re-checks the requestId after the provider call so a concurrent run appends nothing. Revocation resumes a period-end cancel that was recorded between its two stream reads. sync-subscription stamps the snapshot time as providerEventAtIso so a late older webhook cannot reactivate a synced cancellation.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: waitlist
  type: fix
  title: Link-on-signup failures, legacy re-run and purge audit order
  detail: link-on-signup throws when the entry update fails and the entry is still invited, so the consumer redelivers. The offlot legacy migration skips rows that are already imports. purge writes its audit event before shredding keys.
  -->
- 374a12b: Review fixes: tenant destroy sweep keeps a minimum slice per tenant, inbound-mail polling skips any account whose address fails to decrypt, the delivery preferences query reports renamed notification types under their current name, and a deduplicated job add no longer resets a finished tenant run row.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: tenant-lifecycle
  type: fix
  title: Destroy sweep keeps a minimum time slice per tenant
  detail: With many tenants in destroying state the shared tick budget no longer shrinks a tenant's slice below two seconds, so chunking hooks make progress instead of failing the stage as no-progress attempts.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: inbound-mail-foundation
  type: fix
  title: Undecryptable mail account no longer stops polling of other accounts
  detail: Any decryption failure of an account address (corrupt envelope, missing key, AAD mismatch) is logged by error class and the account is skipped; the other accounts keep polling.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: delivery
  type: fix
  title: Preferences query reports renamed notification types under the current name
  detail: Rows stored under a former notification name are returned with the current name and collapsed per channel with the delivery precedence (current-name row wins, otherwise any disabled row disables), so settings screens show the effective state.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: jobs
  type: fix
  title: Deduplicated job add keeps the finished tenant run row
  detail: JobQueuedMeta carries the BullMQ creation time of the job. The queued hook only removes finished rows queued before that time (leftovers of a Redis reset), so re-announcing an already finished job no longer turns its row back into queued.
  -->
- cecdf71: CLI and dev-server hardening: managed/scripts checks warn before adoption, sync-managed resolves the repo root, resources are released on boot failure, late-bound revokers unbind safely, server lockfile is verified.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: cli
  type: fix
  title: check, sync-managed and backfill-pii handle failure and subdirectories correctly
  detail: kumiko check only warns about unresolvable managed files or package.json scripts until kumiko.config.ts calls defineAppConfig. sync-managed resolves the repo root like check instead of using cwd. ops backfill-pii closes the KMS wiring when registry creation fails. The agent command reuses allAppFeatures from the framework config.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: dev-server
  type: fix
  title: runDevApp releases the KMS on any boot failure; server lockfile is verified
  detail: runDevApp closes the KMS wiring when a boot gate throws before the server is created. Stopping one app no longer replaces the session, MFA and PAT revokers a newer app bound on the same feature instances: the bind functions of sessions, auth-mfa and personal-access-tokens return an unbind that only clears its own binding. writeServerLockfile replays the frozen install the runtime image runs, so a lock that did not re-resolve fails in kumiko-build.
  -->
- 37db191: Template resolver and directory fixes: linking a PDF no longer replaces an inline image under the same key, by-tenant loads shadowing system templates once per kind instead of per row, tenant-override-counts reads only the columns it needs, tenant-overrides resolves labels for exactly the tenants and users it lists (tenant and member directories accept an optional ids filter), and array parameters of the notification preference and form-draft cleanup queries use Postgres array literals.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: template-resolver
  type: fix
  title: Template overrides, key collisions and by-tenant queries
  detail: link-pdf refuses a key that already holds an inline image (key_in_use). by-tenant no longer runs a query per row, tenant-override-counts selects only the needed columns, and tenant-overrides resolves names beyond the first 200 tenants or users through the new ids filter of the tenant and member directories. Notification preference and form-draft cleanup queries bind array parameters as Postgres array literals.
  -->
- 2924949: Template seeding no longer undoes admin decisions, and copy-locale rejects a source that changed during the upload.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: template-resolver
  type: fix
  title: Re-seeding keeps archived system templates, drops stale drafts and adds only missing bundle locales
  detail: A boot-time re-seed no longer reactivates an archived system template and clears an open system draft when the seeded content changes. A bundle with resources seeded with ifExists skip imports only the missing locales instead of overwriting existing system rows. copy-locale fails with version_conflict when its source changed between the upload and the transaction, and releases the uploaded files.
  -->
- c52702e: Review follow-ups: the audit list cursor comment names the real 400 status, the `dispatchToolCall` JSDoc states that local validation errors carry no `code`, and the agent tool, audit, auth and billing integration tests gain coverage and isolation fixes.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: agent-tools
  type: fix
  title: dispatchToolCall documents which failures carry a code

  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: audit

  <!-- kumiko-changes

  detail: Integration tests now check that a delegating tool handler keeps the cross-tenant-read marker closed, that an erased subject gets no consumer-protection mail, and that the anonymous change-password check runs once; the audit seed helper uses withEnv.

- b62e6cd: Review fixes for billing-foundation consumer protection and cap-counter tests: ordered lists keep their numbers in the contract confirmation mail, the revoke paragraph uses a typed show-if option, the stored user email decrypt helper is shared, the receipt mail distinguishes a rate limit from an unavailable limiter, an abandoned checkout no longer reopens the withdrawal period, and a same-second update no longer revives a canceled subscription.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes

  <!-- kumiko-changes

  type: fix
  title: Operator notice tells an unavailable receipt limiter from a reached limit

  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: billing-foundation
  type: fix
  title: Same-second provider update cannot revive a canceled subscription
  detail: When a non-terminal state event carries the same provider timestamp as a stored cancellation, it is treated as late and discarded.
  -->
- 1e3e94d: Review fixes: a consume on a released cap reservation keeps its tombstone alive, calendar cap periods are validated on every enforcement, stock caps serialize on the counted set instead of the error code, forget-subject writes its audit event even when the record owner lookup fails, and the email channel docs describe what happens without an app transport.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: cap-counter
  type: fix
  title: Consume on a released reservation extends its tombstone
  detail: Every consume against a released reservation tombstone now pushes its expiry out, so a long-running job that consumes across the sweep can no longer lose the tombstone and have its earlier units counted twice at settle.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: cap-counter
  type: fix
  title: Misconfigured cap period fails on every enforcement
  detail: A periodEndIso that is unparsable or not after periodStartIso now throws on each enforceCap or reservation call instead of only once the hard cap is reached, so a bad period no longer turns into a 500 at the limit instead of cap_exceeded.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: cap-counter
  type: fix
  title: Stock cap lock covers the counted rows, not the error code
  detail: withStockCap serializes on the table and where filter that are counted, so two handlers capping the same rows under different codes can no longer both pass the check in parallel and exceed the cap together.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: crypto-shredding
  type: fix
  title: forget-subject audit event survives a failing record owner lookup
  detail: The lookup of the record row's owning tenant now runs inside the file purge step, so a database error there is reported as cleanupError on the subject-forgotten event instead of aborting the handler after the key was erased.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: channel-email
  type: fix
  title: Corrected description of an email channel without app transport
  detail: Without an app transport only notifications declared with tenantTransport true are delivered; all others fail with missing_credentials, so such apps must mark every outgoing notification or keep an app transport.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: config
  type: fix
  title: Remove unreachable branch in configRowHoldsValue
  detail: The undefined key definition is now handled together with the plaintext comparison, dropping a dead return without changing behavior.
  -->
- 084c9c0: Review fixes: an inline mail image no longer swallows transient storage errors, the unsubscribe tenant origin is resolved once per notify call, one-click unsubscribe POSTs keep the JSON rejection, the resubscribe limit has its own page text, and form drafts fail loudly when the PII key service is missing.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: delivery
  type: fix
  title: Inline mail image retries on transient storage errors
  detail: Only a missing file storage for the file's tenant sends the mail without the inline image; any other read error (timeout, provider failure, DB) is rethrown so the send job retries instead of mailing without the logo.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: delivery
  type: fix
  title: Unsubscribe tenant origin resolved once per notify call
  detail: The app's tenantOrigin callback runs once per notify call and tenant instead of once per recipient and channel, so a newsletter no longer causes one lookup and one fallback warning per address. The docs state the callback must only return verified, active domains.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: delivery
  type: fix
  title: One-click unsubscribe POST keeps the JSON rejection
  detail: RFC 8058 one-click POSTs (form body List-Unsubscribe=One-Click) answer an invalid or expired token with the JSON 400 again and skip the branding lookup; only browser form submits get the HTML page.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: delivery
  type: fix
  title: Resubscribe limit page has its own text
  detail: A browser that hits the resubscribe limit sees that the address cannot be subscribed again here, instead of the generic "try again later" error (new key mail.unsubscribe.resubscribeLimitReached in en, de, es, fr, it).
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: form-draft
  type: fix
  title: Encrypted drafts without a PII key service raise an error
  detail: Reading a ciphertext draft with no PII subject key service configured throws instead of returning an empty draft, so the stale-draft cleanup defers it and no longer releases its file refs as if it were empty.
  -->
- c5b197e: Review fixes: the mailbox rename audit reason is derived from the caller role, inbound-mail seen-id lookups run in chunks, the tenant mail transport falls back to the app transport without tenant config, and renderTablePdf enforces the document size caps for direct callers.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: inbound-mail-foundation
  type: fix
  title: Rename audit reason comes from the caller role
  detail: update-account records tenant_admin or system_admin from the caller's roles and honors a client-supplied reason only for the system identity, so a form call can no longer write system reasons such as watch_supervisor. The rename form no longer carries a reason field and the reason payload field is optional.

  <!-- kumiko-changes

- c2a97fd: Review fixes: the step-dispatcher deliver job rejects an invalid payload at the trigger instead of burning its retries, the collection-refused and tier-assignment-source guards are type predicates built on isOneOf, and the stale-customer, locale-title, copy-locale and test-mail behaviors are covered by tests.

## 0.387.0

### Patch Changes

- 10d7581: Source comments in bundled-features are English and no longer carry issue numbers or planning labels.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: improvement
  title: English source comments without issue references in bundled-features
  detail: Comments in bundled-features are translated to English, and issue numbers and planning labels are removed while the reason they stood for stays. Pure paraphrases of the code are dropped. No code changes.
  -->
- c25b54f: Suspect `as` casts in framework, types, bundled-features and renderer replaced by type guards, Zod checks at input boundaries and typing at the source.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: fix
  title: Fewer unchecked casts, runtime checks at boundaries
  detail: bridgeStub needs no casts, the db dialect types drop any (TableColumns is SchemaTable, SelectQuery is unknown). Malformed input now fails at the boundary instead of later, for example a step that returns a non-WriteResult as the pipeline result, a non-numeric Redis counter in the login rate limiter, or r.useExtension, r.referenceData, r.job, r.notification, r.metric, r.secret, r.secretNamespace, r.claimKey and r.relation called without their required argument. Snapshot.generatedAt is optional, so snapshots written without it still load. The cast baseline is rewritten so new suspect casts in a file fail the As-Casts Audit.
  -->
- de7a63d: Follow-ups from the review of the logger and cast changes: console fallbacks without a stray `undefined`, a fail-closed projection allowlist walker, typed savepoint handles.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: fix
  title: Fail-closed projection allowlist walk, cleaner fallback log lines
  detail: createFallbackLogger no longer prints a trailing `undefined` when a log call carries no data. The step walker shared by the projection allowlist check and the workflow event-trigger registration now aborts with path and index when a sub-step list holds an entry that is not a step, instead of skipping it. The `unknown` overload of `runInSavepoint` hands its callback a `DbRunner`. Log lines drop doubled namespace prefixes, and the remaining errors in eager-load, the event store and the token request route travel as structured fields.
  -->

## 0.386.0

### Patch Changes

- f0a9e8f: Handlers and jobs can read across tenants without taking the raw runner.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: improvement
  title: ctx.crossTenantReads for handlers with the crossTenantReads grant
  detail: A handler whose `escapeHatch` lists `grants: ["crossTenantReads"]` (or `unsafeRaw`, which implies it) gets `ctx.crossTenantReads` with `selectMany`, `fetchOne` and `count`, unfiltered by tenant and including the events table. Every call is audited as `cross-tenant-read`; `ctx.db.unsafeRaw()` stays denied for the read-only grant, and neither a member-resolution read nor an agent tool call (`dispatchToolCall`, including handlers it reaches through nested `ctx.query`/`ctx.write`) ever receives the surface, so cross-tenant rows cannot reach an LLM context. Jobs use the same grant. The internal `runAsDirectCallEntry` (`/internal/request-context`) now also marks its scope as an agent tool call. Without the grant nothing changes.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: types
  type: improvement
  title: RawDbClient is typed instead of any
  detail: `RawDbClient.unsafe` and `begin` have real signatures, so `db.unsafe(...)` on a `DbConnection` no longer collapses to `any`. A hand-built fake runner needs `unsafe(sql, params?)` returning rows and a `begin` that takes a callback.
  -->

## 0.385.0

### Minor Changes

- 3b011a8: Apps can require every translation key to exist in a fixed set of locales.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: improvement
  title: requiredLocales boot option
  detail: `validateBootOptions.requiredLocales` (also `VALIDATE_BOOT_OPTIONS` in kumiko/schema.ts) makes boot fail when any translation key of the mounted features lacks one of the listed locales. Locales are combined across features, so locale packages close the gaps of the features they translate. Without the option nothing changes. This replaces the locale list the i18n-keys guard read from `src/i18n-guard-locales.ts` until 0.384.0; without that file it checked `["de", "en"]`.
  migration: Define the option once, e.g. `{ requiredLocales: ["de", "en"] }`, pass it as `validateBootOptions` wherever the app boots (`runProdApp`, `runDevApp`, workers) and re-export it as `VALIDATE_BOOT_OPTIONS` from `kumiko/schema.ts` so `kumiko-schema validate` checks it in CI. The check covers framework and bundled keys too; a key missing a locale fails boot with the feature and key named.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: personal-access-tokens
  type: improvement
  title: patScopeOptionKey for translating token scope labels
  detail: The scope labels personal-access-tokens generates from `scopes[domain].label` are English only. `patScopeOptionKey(domain, "read" | "write")` returns their translation key, so an app feature can add the other locales with `r.translations`.
  migration: Apps that mount personal-access-tokens and set `requiredLocales` with a locale other than `en` translate each generated scope label (`read`, plus `write` where the domain offers it) under `patScopeOptionKey`.
  -->

### Patch Changes

- 9950dd0: selectMany can read the newest row per key with `distinctOn`, the renderer view-model inputs accept a narrower entity, and two new ratchets cap oversized files and legit casts.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: improvement
  title: selectMany distinctOn for newest-row-per-key reads
  detail: SelectOptions.distinctOn takes field names and emits SELECT DISTINCT ON over them, keeping the first row per key by orderBy, so newest-row-per-key reads no longer need unsafeRaw. orderBy has to start with the distinctOn fields in the same order, otherwise selectMany throws; without orderBy it defaults to them ascending. Tenant scoping applies as for every selectMany. Error classification and driver detection drop the branches for the removed Bun.SQL driver (ERR_POSTGRES_* codes, SQLSTATE in errno, millisecond timeouts), which postgres-js never produces.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: types
  type: improvement
  title: SelectOptions.distinctOn and split screen types
  detail: SelectOptions gains the optional distinctOn field. The screen type definitions are split into several files below 2000 lines; the import paths of the exported types are unchanged.
  -->

  feature: renderer
  type: improvement
  title: View-model inputs take only the entity parts they read
  detail: ComputeEditViewModelInput.entity and ComputeListViewModelInput.entity are typed as the Pick of EntityDefinition they actually read, so synthesized entities need no cast. Passing a full EntityDefinition keeps working. Renderer console output goes through one dev-console module.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: guards
  type: improvement
  title: File Size guard and per-package ratchet for legit casts
  detail: The File Size guard freezes production files above 2000 lines in `.kumiko-file-size-baseline.json` and fails when a file grows or a new one crosses the limit. The As-Casts Audit additionally caps legit-bridge and legit-boundary casts per package in `.kumiko-cast-legit-baseline.json`. Without the baseline files both only warn.
  migration: Optional. Freeze both with `kumiko-guards guards --write-baseline --guard="File Size"` and `--guard="As-Casts Audit"`.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: auth-email-password
  type: improvement
  title: Denser common-password list, comments name postgres-js as the only driver
  detail: The common-password list is wrapped densely and split on whitespace; a test pins its 2086 entries. Comments across the bundled features that referred to the removed Bun.SQL driver now name postgres-js. No behavior change.

  <!-- kumiko-changes

## 0.384.0

### Minor Changes

- c28119a: The Unsafe-Append-Event guard is removed because the event store enforces the same rules at runtime.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: guards
  type: improvement
  title: Unsafe-Append-Event guard removed
  detail: The event store rejects unregistered event types and validates every payload against its schema at runtime, for appendEvent and unsafeAppendEvent alike, so the static guard is redundant.
  migration: Delete `.kumiko-unsafe-append-event-baseline.json`.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: guards
  type: improvement
  title: Access-Denied-Test guard replaced by a contract test helper
  detail: Roles are checked centrally before the payload is parsed. The new `expectRoleRestrictedHandlersDenyForeignRole` test helper proves this over HTTP for every role-restricted write and query handler, so the guard that searched for a matching test per handler is removed.
  migration: In an app integration test with setupTestStack and the app features, call `expectRoleRestrictedHandlersDenyForeignRole(stack)` and remove the "Access-Denied-Test Guard" entry from `.kumiko-security-baseline.json`.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: guards
  type: improvement
  title: i18n-Keys guard no longer checks locales
  detail: The guard only reports keys that are used without a definition. Locale completeness moved to the boot validator, which sees the real registered translations of every feature.
  migration: Delete `src/i18n-guard-locales.ts` if it exists.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: breaking
  title: Boot fails when a feature leaves a locale out of some of its translation keys
  detail: Within one feature, every translation key must carry every locale that any key of the same feature carries. A missing locale or an empty string fails boot with one error listing all gaps. Features with a single locale across all keys are unaffected, as are locale packages. A plural object counts as present.
  migration: Add the missing locale to each listed key, or move that locale out of the feature into a locale package.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: guards
  type: improvement
  title: PII-Annotations guard removed
  detail: Entity text and longText fields now have to declare their personal stance by type and at boot, so the static guard that searched for unannotated fields is redundant.
  migration: Delete `.kumiko-pii-annotations-baseline.json`.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: breaking
  title: Entity text fields must declare a personal stance
  detail: FieldsMap requires the personal stance of text and longText fields by type, and boot throws for such a field without one. The name heuristic for PII-typical names stays a warning and only applies to other field types.

## 0.383.0

### Minor Changes

- 9ef4b39: Production logging and shutdown hardening: one process logger with redaction and request context, a client-error endpoint, a required trusted-proxy setting, fatal-error handlers, a graceful server stop, fail-open rate limits during a Redis outage and masked delivery-log addresses.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: improvement
  title: Process logger, request context fields and redaction
  detail: runProdApp and runWorkerApp install a pino process logger (JSON in production) that every createFallbackLogger without an explicit logger resolves lazily, with a component field. Log lines carry requestId, correlationId, tenantId, userId, feature and handler from the request context; jobs carry tenantId and userId too. Keys such as password, token, secret, apiKey, authorization, cookie, set-cookie, x-api-key, sessionToken, privateKey, credentials, otp, iban and email are redacted to [redacted] up to depth 2. New scrubLogText masks e-mail addresses, JWTs, bearer tokens and Postgres key details in server-fault, job-failure and client-error logs.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: server-runtime
  type: improvement
  title: Production logs are plain JSON without the [runProdApp] prefix
  detail: Behavior change for log parsers and alert rules: runProdApp and runWorkerApp now write one JSON object per line from the process logger, without the former "[runProdApp]" text prefix. Match on the component field instead of the prefix.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: improvement
  title: POST /api/client-errors collects browser error reports
  detail: Anonymous endpoint with a strict body (errorId, kind, message, stack, screen, path, buildVersion), an 8 KB cap (413), 400 without echo, a per-IP limit of 10 per minute (429, in memory per process when Redis is absent) and 204 on success. The report is logged as a scrubbed warning; the query and hash of the path are cut. With a session the report carries tenantId and userId.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: server-runtime
  type: breaking
  title: runProdApp requires trustedProxyHops in production
  detail: In production runProdApp refuses to boot when neither the trustedProxyHops option, the auth option nor KUMIKO_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS is set. An explicit 0 is allowed. create-kumiko-app templates write KUMIKO_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=0 into .env.example.
  migration: set KUMIKO_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=<hops> (0 when the app is exposed directly) or pass trustedProxyHops
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: server-runtime
  type: improvement
  title: Fatal-error handlers and graceful server stop
  detail: New installFatalErrorHandlers logs uncaughtException and unhandledRejection, stops the app and exits 1 (hard exit after 10 s). runProdApp and runWorkerApp install it. The HTTP server stop is awaited against a 10 s grace period and then forced before the database closes.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: improvement
  title: Global IP and http-route limits fail open when Redis is down
  detail: Behavior change: previously a Redis error answered 503 on these two limits. The l1-global-ip and http-route limits let the request through on a Redis error instead of answering 503, count it in kumiko_rate_limit_fail_open_total{label} and log a warning at most every 30 s. The l2-auth-endpoints and login/MFA limits stay fail-closed. A Redis client that is not ready fails fast instead of waiting for the command timeout. Redis connection loss and recovery are logged once per state change.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: breaking
  title: globalIpRateLimit and httpRouteRateLimit option onFailClosed is now onFailOpen
  detail: The option is renamed because both limits now let the request through on a Redis error; the callback receives the error and is throttled to one warning per 30 s. Both limits also accept a meter for kumiko_rate_limit_fail_open_total.
  migration: rename onFailClosed to onFailOpen in globalIpRateLimit and httpRouteRateLimit options; the callback no longer implies a 503, the request continues
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: auth-email-password
  type: improvement
  title: Warning when the login limiter falls back to memory in production
  detail: The in-memory login and MFA rate limiter logs one warning per process in production, because its limits are per replica.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: delivery
  type: fix
  title: delivery-log projection masks the recipient address
  detail: The inline projection now masks the address with the same helper as the write path, also on rebuild, so legacy events with a full address no longer reach the attempt log. Already masked addresses and connection-name channels stay unchanged. Swallowed errors in the snapshot save, queue-depth poll and channel pre-resolve now log a scrubbed warning.
  -->
- 9ef4b39: Database load and pagination hardening plus a job-defer API: server-side statement (60 s) and idle-in-transaction (300 s) timeouts, concurrent session lookups, page-only tenant decryption, keyset scans in reindex, purge and escape-hatch retention, and `ctx.defer(ms)` for jobs.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: improvement
  title: Prod and worker pools cap statements at 60 s and idle transactions at 300 s
  detail: Behavior change, not an API break. runProdApp and runWorkerApp now open their Postgres pools with statement_timeout 60 s and idle_in_transaction_session_timeout 300 s (handlers that await external calls inside a transaction are not killed early, leaked transactions still end), so one runaway query or a transaction left open no longer holds a connection indefinitely. lock_timeout stays off. Opt out per limit by setting the variable to 0, or change it, with DATABASE_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS, DATABASE_IDLE_IN_TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT_MS and DATABASE_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS (for example DATABASE_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS=0); createDbConnection takes statementTimeoutMs, idleInTransactionSessionTimeoutMs and lockTimeoutMs. Migrations, projection and multi-stream rebuilds, search reindex, PII backfills and the CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY helpers run without the statement cap (withoutStatementTimeout). A custom long-running statement on the app pool now needs the same helper or a higher limit.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: sessions
  type: improvement
  title: sessionChecker looks up the user and the membership concurrently
  detail: The session check starts the user lookup together with the session read and the membership lookup together with the last-seen refresh. Results and the fail-open behavior are unchanged; a failed lookup that is not needed no longer raises an unhandled rejection.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: cap-overview
  type: improvement
  title: Tenant caps list decrypts only the visible page
  detail: Without a search and with a sort other than name, the list loads light tenant rows, pages them, and fetches and decrypts names for the current page only. The default name sort and any search still decrypt every tenant, because tenant names are stored encrypted and cannot be sorted or filtered in SQL. Order, total and rows are unchanged.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: tenant
  type: improvement
  title: Tenant directory search stops decrypting once the limit is reached
  detail: Tenant names are encrypted and not in the search index, so the directory search decrypts in small batches and stops after limit matches; the 1000-row scan cap stays. With more matches than the limit, the first matches in key order are returned (sorted by label), not the best alphabetical ones. The missing-profile list drops tenants that already have a profile before decrypting.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: fix
  title: Reindex and subject purge scan by keyset instead of OFFSET
  detail: reindexEntity and the subject purge page with WHERE id > last ORDER BY id LIMIT n, so rows deleted or changed while the scan runs no longer make it skip later rows.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: audit
  type: improvement
  title: Escape-hatch retention loads only needed columns, in keyset pages
  detail: The retention run groups tenants only over events older than the shortest cutoff, selects id, aggregateId, createdAt and payload, and prunes per 2000-row keyset page instead of loading every row with its full payload.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: jobs
  type: breaking
  title: Job handlers can return ctx.defer(ms)
  detail: A handler that returns ctx.defer(ms) moves the queue job to delayed and runs again after ms, like the maxPerTenant defer. It consumes no retry attempt and records no failure, failure log or failed run; the run row of the deferred pass is removed and a tenantVisibleRun record goes back to queued. maxDefers on the job (default 100, shared counter with maxPerTenant defers) bounds the loop; exceeding it fails the run for good (no retry) with a clear message. Inline runs (boot gates) throw. New run-logger hook onJobDeferred, passed through the entrypoint jobs options. JobHandlerFn may now return a JobDeferral. JobContext has a required defer member.
  migration: add defer to every hand-built JobContext object (tests, seeds), e.g. defer: (delayMs) => ({ kind: "job-deferral", delayMs })
  -->

### Patch Changes

- 07ccdc9: The compile-time write lock on event-fed tables is fail-closed: a write compiles only for a Writable table or a runner that carries the executor capability, so type-erased tables are rejected instead of accepted.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: framework
  type: breaking
  title: Writes compile only for Writable tables or capable runners
  detail: The negative ExecutorOnly brand is replaced by positive brands. table(), defineUnmanagedTable and deriveEntityTableMeta with source "unmanaged" return Writable tables; buildEntityTable and r.projection tables do not. insertOne, updateMany, deleteMany, the upsert and counter helpers and the TenantDb and db.global() write methods accept a Writable table, or any table when the runner is an ExecutorManagedRunner or ExecutorManagedTenantDb. Widening a table to SchemaTable or EntityTableMeta drops the brand, so erased tables no longer compile. Projection apply functions receive tx as ExecutorManagedRunner. The runtime lock is unchanged.
  migration: Apply functions that annotate `tx` as `DbRunner`, inline or standalone, type it as `ExecutorManagedRunner` (or drop the annotation / annotate the function with SingleStreamApplyFn/MultiStreamApplyFn). Own write helpers take `WritableTable` for direct-write tables, or `ExecutorManagedRunner` / `ExecutorManagedTenantDb` when they write event-fed tables from an apply, rebuild or tenant-destroy context, instead of `SchemaTable`/`EntityTableMeta`. Tables annotated as `SchemaTable` lose the `Writable` brand; drop the annotation or add `& Writable`. Tenant-destroy hooks keep using the db they receive. Affects kumiko-enterprise, solon, money-horse, kumiko-studio, publicstatus.
  -->

  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: files
  type: improvement

  detail: A files or images field of an actionForm screen uploads through POST /files with actionForm=<screen QN> and fieldName; the file is stored pending under the screen and the route checks the caller's access to the screen and its handler before writing bytes. Pending actionForm uploads are removed on user forget and by the forget-subject file purge. New i18n keys kumiko.widget.upload.too-large|invalid-type|max-count|remove, kumiko.field.dropzone.* and errors.file.violatesBindTarget (de, es, fr, it included).

  detail: stop() swaps the session and PAT revokers that boot bound onto the auth-mfa, sessions and personal-access-tokens feature instances for inert ones, and those features now accept a new binding on a second boot instead of keeping the first. A later app or test stack on the same feature instances no longer reaches the closed database connection.

  detail: New queries audit:query:list-all-tenants and audit:query:details-all-tenants (SystemAdmin only) return the audit trail of every tenant, each row with its tenantId, filterable by tenant.   detail: The web EventSource reconnects with exponential backoff and jitter after a refused handshake unless the session ended, rewires every subscribed entity on the new connection and sends each listener a LIVE_RESYNC_EVENT_TYPE event after a reconnect, because frames during the gap are lost. useQuery and the nav tree refetch in the background and collapse a burst of live events into one trailing run (LIVE_REFETCH_COALESCE_MS); an event during a running fetch queues exactly one follow-up.   type: fix
  title: A slow SSE client no longer buffers without bound
  detail: The SSE route tracks the writes a client has not consumed. Only the entity executor, projection apply and rebuild, declared unsafe projection steps, tenant-destroy hooks and the new deleteRowsWithoutReplayableStream helper may write them. unsafeRaw() no longer unlocks them.

  feature: framework
  type: breaking
  title: Direct writes on event-fed tables throw at runtime
  detail: buildEntityTable and r.projection mark their tables. insertOne, updateMany, deleteMany, the upsert and counter helpers, ctx.db write methods and db.global() writes throw AccessDeniedError on a marked table unless the runner carries the framework write capability. The executor, projection apply, rebuild, unsafeProjectionDelete, tenant-destroy hooks and deleteRowsWithoutReplayableStream hold it; ctx.db.unsafeRaw() never does. Retention deletes only rows whose stream is gone or archived. The cascade delete hook, the soft-delete purge jobs and seedReferenceData now write through the executor, so their effect survives a rebuild; cascade children are written as the system user, and softDelete children are soft-deleted instead of hard-deleted. The direct-entity-writes guard has no exceptions left.
  migration: Write event-fed rows through the executor (r.crud, ctx.write, createEventStoreExecutor). Projection apply functions must use the db they receive. Test seeds and teardown use seedRow, seedRows, updateRows, deleteRows and clearTables from kumiko-testing instead of hand-written wipe helpers. Do not pass ctx.db.unsafeRaw() to code that deletes event-fed rows; pass ctx.db inside a tenant-destroy hook. Retention code calls deleteRowsWithoutReplayableStream after pruning or archiving the events. seedReferenceData takes the registry instead of a table map. Affects kumiko-enterprise, kumiko-studio and solon.
  -->

## 0.378.0

### Minor Changes

- 2d7ee3e: Document PDFs can embed the images of a record
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: template-resolver
  type: improvement
  title: Document PDFs embed the images of a record
  detail: A template variable of type images (templateVariable.images()) holds FileRef ids of the record. The new Images block (div[data-images], PDF templates only, rejected for mail kinds) renders them as data-URI images in the real PDF render. Only files of the rendering tenant are read, only png, jpeg, gif and webp, at most 24 images and 20 MB per document; missing, foreign, oversized or non-image ids are dropped silently. Previews and draft PDFs never read files and show one placeholder box per block. An images variable never renders as inline text. i18n keys template-resolver.documentEditor.images, template-resolver.documentEditor.imagesVariable and templateResolver.errors.document.imagesBlockPdfOnly ship in de, es, fr and it.
  migration: Declare a template variable with type `images`, place the Images block, and pass FileRef ids of the record in `variables`. Images resolve only in the real PDF render, previews show placeholders. The ids must come from the record on the server, never from client input: a resolved id is read for the whole tenant without an entity access check.
  -->

  A selector owner without panels now generates one configEdit screen `<owner>-tenant` instead of a dashboard around a dormant `<owner>-tenant-selection` form. The provider select gets an empty option for "no own provider", labelled by `<field label key>.platformDefault` or the generic `config.settings.provider.platformDefault`.

- a08f6d6: Only the SystemAdmin edits templates by default. An app unlocks TenantAdmins per kind and slug with `createTemplateResolverFeature({ tenantEditable: [{ kind, slug, access }] })`; reading and delivery are unchanged. Template collections without an `access` rule are SystemAdmin-only. The document designer takes `createDocumentDesignerFeature({ access })` for its editor screens, and `composeRendererStack` passes `templateResolver` options through.
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: template-resolver
  type: breaking
  title: Template editing is SystemAdmin-only unless the app unlocks it
  detail: Every tenant write handler, the overview and resource upload accept SystemAdmin only, plus the roles of the tenantEditable entries. A write on a template that is not unlocked fails with templateNotTenantEditable. The test send follows the same rule. For a non-SystemAdmin an unknown template id answers 403 like a locked one, so the response does not reveal whether it exists. Collections without an access rule default to SystemAdmin.
  migration: Where TenantAdmins must keep editing a template, pass tenantEditable to createTemplateResolverFeature, for example tenantEditable: [{ kind: "mail", slug: "billing:notify:invoice-issued", access: { roles: ["TenantAdmin"] } }]. Give template collections an explicit access rule if tenants should manage them.
  -->

  feature: document-designer
  type: breaking
  title: Designer screens are SystemAdmin-only unless the app passes access
  detail: The templates screen, layout, PDF and mail editors are visible to SystemAdmin only by default. createDocumentDesignerFeature takes an optional access rule whose roles are added.
  migration: Pass createDocumentDesignerFeature({ access: templateEditAccess(tenantEditable) }) with the same entries given to the template resolver when TenantAdmins edit templates.
  -->
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes
  feature: dev-server
  type: improvement
  title: composeRendererStack forwards templateResolver options
  detail: RendererStackOptions.templateResolver is passed to createTemplateResolverFeature, so an app can set tenantEditable.
  -->
- 6352d97: The pre-push shim no longer executes a `kumiko-pre-push` from an untrusted ancestor. The upward walk ends at `$HOME` (inclusive) and skips ancestors owned by another user or writable by group or others, such as `/tmp`.
  
  `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/search` exports `collectSearchableFieldNames` and `configureTenantSearchIndex`, so apps stop copying the per-tenant index setup. `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime` exports `diskFileRoute`, an anonymous GET route that serves allowlisted disk files with ETag and 304. `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/flow-diagram` exports `renderFlow` and the `FlowSpec` types for static animated SVG flow diagrams.
  
  Stock caps reserve atomically under a per-tenant advisory lock, so two parallel writes can no longer both pass the cap. The document designer ships its own stylesheet, disables Upload when the files feature is not mounted, and disables the test mail with a hint when the server cannot resolve an address (new `send-test-status` query).
  
  <!-- kumiko-changes

  -->

  -->

  -->

  title: flow-diagram subpath

  -->

- 60a29a8: HandlerContext cleanup and persistence docs. `outsideTransaction` is deprecated in favour of `runInOwnTransaction(ctx.dbOutsideTransaction, fn)`. `JobContext._userId` is gone. `ProviderPluginContext` is the public context for provider plugins, built with `providerPluginContextFromHandler` or `providerPluginContextFromJob`; `configAccessorFactory` replaces `_configAccessorFactory`. The migration splitter and the replay parser handle dollar-quoted bodies, RENAME, CREATE TABLE AS and DO blocks. A new guard flags `unsafeAppendEvent` outside migrations, upcasters and tests.

SharedContextFields gains configAccessorFactory; _configAccessorFactory stays as a deprecated alias. dbOutsideTransaction stays TenantDb | undefined (undefined only in the member-resolution and before-transaction denial phases and in platform-metering tenant mode); hasOutsideTransactionDb(ctx) narrows it and requireOutsideTransactionDb(ctx) throws when it is missing.
